title: War With The Beast: Death & Persecution

sense.text: “Blow up the trumpet in the new moon, in the time appointed, on our solemn feast day.” The trumpets are not blown for nothing. There are reasons for blowing them: the trumpet is blown to gather the people together, and it is blown over the burnt offerings.
“For this was a statute for Israel, and a law of the God of Jacob.” Blowing the trumpet in the new moon is a statute and a law.

“He made the moon also to serve in her season for a declaration of times, and a sign of the world.” The moon is what is used to tell the seasons. That is how you are able to tell time, through the moon.

“From the moon is the sign of feasts”: that is how you know when the feast day is coming. And when the moon was created it was “a light that decreaseth in her perfection.” Not a light that increases, a light that decreases. When she is perfect she is a light, and then she decreases.

Today the world has taught our people that the moon is new when it is dark. But when the moon was created, it was a light. That was done to confuse our feast days: if the moon is what tells the feast days, and they throw that off, everything is off.
“The month is called after her name.” The word month is derived from the word moon, “increasing wonderfully in her changing.”

Jehoshaphat stood and said, “Hear me, O Judah, and ye inhabitants of Jerusalem; Believe in the Lord your God, so shall ye be established”. To survive what is coming on this earth, we must believe in the Lord our God and in what the scriptures say. That is how you are established, how you are saved, how you get the kingdom of heaven.

Not only believe the Lord, but “believe his prophets, so shall ye prosper.” That is how you prosper and get the kingdom. And where are his prophets today? We are the prophets. Ever since the apostles passed, the world says there are no more prophets on the earth, but the brothers teaching this truth are prophets, and nobody can say that they are not.

To believe is an action word. When the things we teach are believed, you take action and prepare for what we tell you is going to take place on this earth.

precepts.why:
This proves the prophets are on the earth today. “The vision of all is become unto you as the words of a book”: all the visions the Lord showed Moses, Jeremiah, Ezekiel, Hosea, Zechariah and the rest have become as the words in a book, and that book is the Bible. All the visions of the prophets are written inside it: what happened to us in the past and what is going to happen on this earth in the future.

But it is a book “that is sealed, which men deliver to one that is learned, saying, Read this, I pray thee: and he saith, I cannot”. This Bible is sealed. Everybody cannot look at it and understand what it is saying. The whole of Christianity cannot understand even a simple thing like what Christ looked like. If you do not understand who the children of Israel are today, you will not understand the Bible; you will be all over the place.

“Shall a trumpet be blown in the city, and the people not be afraid?” That trumpet is the prophets’ teaching, us teaching the word of God. “Shall there be evil in a city, and the Lord hath not done it?”

“Surely the Lord God will do nothing, but he revealeth his secret unto his servants the prophets.” The book is sealed, yet you can understand what it is talking about, because God revealed his secrets to you. That is what makes you a prophet: you are able to understand what the Bible is talking about when everybody else cannot. The teachings you are getting come because God revealed these things.

So you must believe the prophets, as Jehoshaphat said.

sense.text: “Speak thou in the ears of my people the words of prophecy, which I will put in thy mouth, saith the Lord”. This is prophecy about death and persecution, about warring with the beast, and the Lord puts it in our mouth.

“And cause them to be written in paper”: the prophecies the Lord gave unto Ezra are written in paper, and that is what we are reading. They are sealed, and only God’s prophets can understand the writings of Ezra. “For they are faithful and true”: what Ezra wrote is going to happen.

“Fear not the imaginations against thee”: do not fear the things people imagine to do to you, the things they try to make up against you. “Let not the incredulity of them trouble thee, that speak against thee.” Incredulity means unbelief. We are out there teaching that we are the children of Israel, that Christ is a black man, that war, famine and destruction are coming, and a lot of our own people do not believe. They say we are a hate group and call us all type of names.

Do not worry when people speak against you. To be a follower of Christ, they will speak against you. You cannot have the state of mind that you are trying to get this world to love you. If you are teaching the truth and this world loves you, something is wrong with you.

“For all the unfaithful shall die in their unfaithfulness.” Every last one of them that is unfaithful and unbelieving will die. So do not worry about the mockery, the lies and the slander you see going on against us, the videos made making a mockery of us. The Lord says all of them will die in their unfaithfulness.

“Behold, saith the Lord, I will bring plagues upon the world; the sword, famine, death, and destruction.” Plagues are coming on this earth: war, death, destruction, famine. That is why the lesson begins with believing the prophets: we are warning you and letting you know what is going to take place.

“For wickedness hath exceedingly polluted the whole earth”. That is what you see today: look all over the earth and all you see is wickedness and evil. That is why the Lord is sending plagues on the earth.

“Therefore will I number you to the sword, and ye shall all bow down to the slaughter: because when I called, ye did not answer”. These are our people that are unbelieving and unfaithful. How does the Most High call our people? Through the prophets: by us going on the street and teaching, by the videos you run across. But you turn away your face, shut your ears, and say these guys are crazy. You did not repent; you did not hear the high calling of God.

“When I spake, ye did not hear; but did evil before mine eyes”: our people stay in the midst of their sins, following Christianity, following another God, worshipping the beast. They “did choose that wherein I delighted not.” God does not delight in the Christian religion, in Judaism, or in being a Muslim, yet that is what they choose.

“Behold, my servants shall eat, but ye shall be hungry: behold, my servants shall drink, but ye shall be thirsty: behold, my servants shall rejoice, but ye shall be ashamed”. We warn the people to repent, that death, famine and destruction are coming, and they do not listen.

On the basic level: famine is coming. Those that believe the Lord and believe the prophets will prepare, as Joseph did. Joseph interpreted the dream of Egypt’s king, understood famine was coming, and prepared, and the Lord used him to save a lot of people. God is not coming down to feed you. My servants shall eat means the leaders will make sure the people prepare for what is coming, so when that time comes you will not be hungry and you will not thirst.

But our people in the world making a mockery of us never prepared. When things get bad on this earth, they are going to try to rob us, to steal our houses and our goods.

precepts.why:
“Even so shall not the plagues be slack to come upon the earth”: the plagues, death, famine and destruction, will not be slack. “And the world shall mourn, and sorrows shall come upon it on every side.” Things are not going to go back to how they used to be. It is going to get worse. Watch the news: war and killing and genocide all over the place, not just in Palestine.

“O my people, hear my word”: the words of God come through the prophets. “Make you ready to the battle”: the prophets are letting you know to be ready for the war that is about to take place, when the dragon comes against us. Read on and it says in those evils to be as pilgrims: you must be willing to up and leave; you cannot stay in one place, because there will be destruction on every side.

How do you make ready for the battle? You become spiritually strong: you study, pray, apply, and build your spirit up. Because in that battle some of us will die, and that is not a bad thing.

“For strangers shall reap their fruits, and spoil their goods, overthrow their houses, and take their children captives, for in captivity and famine shall they get children.” This is future prophecy. If there is famine, why are they taking our goods? Because we prepared. It will be like the walking dead, people hunting for who has food. Some of us will have our goods taken, some our houses, and our children will become captives.

“And they that occupy their merchandise with robbery”: they will be robbing us. Those of you that have food, they will try to rob you. You do not just buy a bunch of food and have nothing to protect your family with; remember what Christ told Peter and the apostles, and read between the lines.

During famine and that civil war they will take some of our goods and some of our houses. That is why you must be willing to make moves and up and leave when things get hot in the city or community you build. We must be building self-sustaining communities, storing food that can last us years, because we do not know how long Jacob’s trouble is going to take. “The more they deck their cities, their houses, their possessions, and their own persons”, “the more will I be angry with them”.

sense.text: “For my name’s sake will I defer mine anger, and for my praise will I refrain for thee, that I cut thee not off.” We are going to be persecuted, but we will not be cut off during that destruction. Some of us will still be alive when the Lord returns.

“Behold, I have refined thee, but not with silver; I have chosen thee in the furnace of affliction.” Many are called but few are chosen, and God chooses us in affliction. That affliction has started on a small scale and it is going to intensify. It is the white men coming down on those of us that believe and teach the gospel of Christ. He is going to allow them to afflict us, and the brothers and sisters that stay faithful and endure, he says, I am going to choose you.

Affliction has to arise, because that is how God does his choosing. You come here and learn the scriptures and the precepts, but when things get real, will you stand ten toes down in this truth, or take off your fringes and run and hide? Is this a little get-together group to you, is this church to you? If any one of us wants the kingdom of heaven, we have to go through the affliction.

That is why the brothers have to be strong and not weak, offended at everything. The world is against you. Build yourself up so you can endure that affliction, because that is the only way you are going to be chosen.

precepts.why:
“Whosoever remaineth from all these that I have told thee shall escape”: whoever remains from all the trouble and destruction, Jacob’s trouble and the world war, meaning whoever was not killed. A lot of us will die during that destruction. But some brothers will escape it: the famine, the robbing of houses, the stealing of goods.

They will “see my salvation, and the end of your world”: they will see Christ return and be delivered up out of here. Some that believed in Christ will be alive to see this world, Esau’s society, come to an end. “And the men that are received shall see it, who have not tasted death from their birth.” Some brothers will survive it. But some of us will not; a lot of us will not. That is why the Lord says, O my people, prepare for the battle.

“Confirming the souls of the disciples, and exhorting them to continue in the faith”. That is the leaders’ job: to exhort you to continue in this walk, to let nothing take you out of this truth, and to prepare you for what is coming.

“And that we must through much tribulation enter into the kingdom of God.” You are not getting the kingdom of God unless you go through tribulation. Another word for tribulation is persecution. Why does it come? So the Lord can see if you are worthy of the kingdom. That much tribulation is the furnace of affliction.

This shows why much tribulation will come upon us. “What I tell you in darkness, that speak ye in light”: whatever Christ told us as a secret, in parables and dark sayings, the secrets the Lord revealed to his prophets, we are to speak in the light. “And what ye hear in the ear, that preach ye upon the housetops”: go on the housetop and teach it, let everybody hear.

And while you teach and everybody hears, what happens? “And fear not them which kill the body”. Teaching the gospel of Christ, you could end up getting killed, and some of us will be killed for this gospel. Some of us will go to prison. That is real talk, and that is why you must believe the prophets.

They are “not able to kill the soul”: when they kill this body, you go back to your Lord, back to the King; you are not really dead. “But rather fear him which is able to destroy both soul and body in hell.” Christ is saying, you better fear me and do what I said, and teach, no matter if they are going to kill you.

sense.text:
“We have heard a voice of trembling, of fear, and not of peace.” This goes into Jacob’s trouble, into war, into the beast making war with the saints. The Lord says prepare for the battle: war is coming, and you are not going to have a peaceful life following after Christ. You will have to go through the furnace of affliction; that is how he will choose you.

It would be a lie to say that learning here in IUIC everything will be good with you in this world. The government will come down on us. Some of us will go to prison; some of us will be put to death. Things will get very bad. It is said truthfully so that you prepare, and those that believe will say, that is what the bishops and deacons were talking about, and it is happening.

“Wherefore do I see every man with his hands on his loins, as a woman in travail”? Because of persecution. Brothers will be crying and bawling to the Lord for deliverance and help, like a woman giving birth.

“And all faces are turned into paleness.” All faces are speaking of the saints, the elect, us in the last days. The time is going to come when we all will be afraid of what they will be doing to us.

“Alas! for that day is great, so that none is like it: it is even the time of Jacob’s trouble”. Jacob’s trouble begins when the beast makes war with us, when they start murdering us and killing us for the word of God. It ends when Christ comes and destroys our enemies. It runs right up to the world war, the third woe, and it could last years.

“But he shall be saved out of it.” Some of us will never taste death. But not everybody is going to live through Jacob’s trouble, and even if you die you are still saved, because you will be with the Lord.

precepts.why: “Concerning the house of Jacob, Jacob shall not now be ashamed, neither shall his face now wax pale.” This is the twelve tribes of Israel. Faces turning pale in Jeremiah is us being afraid; here our faces will not wax pale any more. We will not be afraid of nobody no more, and nobody will make us cry. That is after the deliverance.

“The remnant of Israel shall not do iniquity, nor speak lies; neither shall a deceitful tongue be found in their mouth”. This is the kingdom. “For they shall feed and lie down, and none shall make them afraid.”

That is what it means when Jacob’s face will not wax pale: nobody oppressing us any more, nobody coming against us, nobody able to kill us or hurt us, because our King is with us. Before that, in Jacob’s trouble, all faces turn into paleness.

sense.text: “The thing that hath been, it is that which shall be”: the thing that has been is man. The same man that has been is the same man that shall be. “And that which is done is that which shall be done”: the same thing man did in the past is the same thing he is going to come and do in the future. “And there is no new thing under the sun.”

“Is there any thing whereof it may be said, See, this is new? it hath been already of old time”. Christ told the apostles they had to come again and teach again, and so the same thing they did in the time of Christ they are back on the earth doing again today. The prophecy says, thou must come again and prophesy again.

So if the apostles and the prophets are back on the earth prophesying again, guess who else is back? Herod, the twelve Caesars, Esau, Cain: all the wicked people you read about in the Bible come back too. That is how this ties in with war with the beast, persecution and affliction.

precepts.why: “That which hath been is named already, and it is known that it is man”. This names the thing that hath been in Ecclesiastes 1:9: it is man. The same men, righteous and wicked, that were on the earth before are on the earth again.

sense.text:
This is speaking of Antiochus Epiphanes, but it is twofold, as Ecclesiastes 1:9 shows. The same affliction and persecution that happened under Antiochus, our people being put to death, is going to happen again in these last days, in Jacob’s trouble.

“And in the latter time of their kingdom”: this is the latter time we are living in. “When the transgressors are come to the full”: transgression is at the full right now; it was not at the full in the time of the Greeks. “A king of fierce countenance”: an evil system, an evil king, a president or leader. “And understanding dark sentences”: they understand that their time is coming to an end, and they understand it through the prophets. They watch us and listen to us, because they cannot understand it on their own.

“And his power shall be mighty, but not by his own power”: the power he has, he got from Satan. This is the system set up today: America as the head, and Europe, the seven heads and ten horns, mainly that little horn. “And shall destroy the mighty and the holy people.” What was done back then is going to be done again today.

“Through his policy also he shall cause craft to prosper in his hand; and he shall magnify himself in his heart”: he sets himself up as God. Does not the white man today magnify himself in his heart? He puts himself as being God, as being Jesus, as being the people of God, the anointed ones, the followers of Christ. “And by peace shall destroy many”.

“He shall also stand up against the Prince of princes”. That is how we know it is talking about the last days. The Prince of princes is Christ, the anointed, our King; in Revelation he is called the King of kings. He is the prince over all princes because he is the heir of everything. To stand up against him means to fight against Christ. It happened in the time of the Greeks, and the same thing is going to happen again today.

precepts.why:
This shows what happened in the time of Antiochus, and it is the same thing we are going to have to deal with today. “King Antiochus wrote to his whole kingdom, that all should be one people, And every one should leave his laws”.

“Yea, many also of the Israelites consented to his religion”. What he set up was a religion, and that religion was idolatry. In the same way, in these last days millions of our people have consented to the religion of the beast. They “sacrificed unto idols”: the image of Cesare Borgia is an idol; the white image of Christ is an idol, and it is called the image of the beast. They “profaned the sabbath”: our people today keep none of the Sabbaths and say the Sabbath is done away with.

“And whosoever would not do according to the commandment of the king, he said, he should die.” Under Antiochus, if you did not worship idols, you were killed. The same thing is going to happen again today.

The persecution, the fire coming to purify us and prove us, is going into forced idol worship: the same system Antiochus set up is going to be set up again. There is a push for a Judeo-Christian nationalist religion, to make religion and state one, and they are going to make it one. Those that speak against the people that call themselves Jews and are not, and against Christianity, will be labelled a terrorist and a hate group. They will be deported, put in prison, and put to death for teaching this Bible the way Christ told us to teach it. America will become a white Christian nationalist country.

sense.text:
This is what the beast is going to do to us, the same thing Antiochus did. That is why Daniel 8 says he will stand up against the Prince of princes: the same system is being set up again today.

“And he had power to give life unto the image of the beast”: the image of the beast is that white image of Christ set up on the earth; they gave that white image the life of Christ. “That the image of the beast should both speak, and cause that as many as would not worship the image of the beast should be killed.”

Many brothers put all nations inside this, but those that will not worship the image of the beast are the twelve tribes of Israel: those of us that repent, that know he is the beast, that keep the commandments. We will be put to death for it. This shows that what is going to take place in America is forced idolatry, the same thing that happened under Antiochus. Those of us that do not support white Christian nationalism, that white racist religion, will be put to death, not only for not supporting it, but because we teach against it, and because millions of our people will wake up, know they are Israel, and stand up against that wickedness.

precepts.why:
“And all that dwell upon the earth shall worship him”. Who is worshipped? The beast, the white man. All these nations worship him in some form, state or fashion, and all of them have the mark of the beast or the number of his name. These are different things: the mark and the number of his name go into his politics; his image goes into his religion.

If you say the people in the land of Israel are the people of God, you have the mark of the beast. Revelation 3:9 calls that blasphemy: you are not supposed to call those people the people of God or the Jews. Some, like the Arabs, are not worshipping his image, his religion, but they still recognise those people as the people of God. The whole world is deceived.

The key is “whose names are not written in the book of life of the Lamb slain from the foundation of the world.” Everybody worships the beast except those whose names are written in the book of life, and those are the twelve tribes of Israel.

This proves whose names are written in the book of life. The wicked are to be “blotted out of the book of the living, and not be written with the righteous.” The righteous are written in the book of the living, and the following verses name them.

“For God will save Zion”: Zion is who is written in the book of the living. “And will build the cities of Judah: that they may dwell there, and have it in possession”: we are going to possess back the land. “The seed also of his servants shall inherit it: and they that love his name shall dwell therein.”

So when Revelation 13:15 says as many as would not worship the image of the beast should be killed, it is talking about the twelve tribes of Israel, those of us written in the book of life.

This proves it is talking about the Israelites. “Them that had gotten the victory over the beast”: the Bible already prophesied that we get the victory over the beast, over the white man, the seven heads and ten horns, America and Europe. “And over his image”: over his religion, which is Christianity. “And over his mark”: his politics, his sins. “And over the number of his name”: all his wickedness. His name is Edom, the man of sin. We get the victory over everything he pushed.

“And they sing the song of Moses the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb”, calling him “thou King of saints.” Christ is the King of Israel, the King of saints, because the saints are the children of Israel.

So in Revelation 13:15, those that would not worship the beast and his image and are killed are those of us in the last days that repented, that are not following Christianity and speak against it. Not all of us, but some of us will be put to death for teaching this gospel and standing against Christianity. And Judaism is inside that too: there could be no Christianity without Judaism. In order for Christianity to be established, the Caucasians had to set themselves up as Jews. If the truth that the Jews are black had been kept, Christianity could not exist.

“For the worshipping of idols not to be named is the beginning, the cause, and the end, of all evil.” The evil set upon the earth in the last days, the beast, his mark and all of that, goes into idolatry: worshipping the image of the beast, worshipping the beast. That is Christianity, and that is going to be the end of all evil.

“Neither was it lawful for a man to keep sabbath days or ancient feasts, or to profess himself at all to be a Jew.” Under Antiochus you could not say you were an Israelite, and you could not keep the feast days. The same thing they are going to do again in these last days.

They see you wearing fringes, they see Israel at the back of your name, and you will become a target. They are setting up laws where it will be unlawful for negroes to say we are the children of Israel: if you say you are a real Jew, they call it anti-Semitic. They will label us a hate group to stop the teachings of Christ, and Esau will set up laws where it is unlawful to go on the street and teach and unlawful to say you are an Israelite. What will you do when that time comes? Prepare yourselves. It has already started; the war is already here.

sense.text: Remember the topic: war with the beast. “The fourth beast, which was diverse from all the others, exceeding dreadful” is the Caucasian race. It “devoured, brake in pieces, and stamped the residue with his feet”: it conquered all nations, all the other beasts. It began with Rome; the ending is Europe and America.

“The ten horns that were in his head” are the ten of the common market, Europe. “The other which came up” is America, “and before whom three fell”: America went to war with France, Spain and Britain for its independence. “Even of that horn that had eyes, and a mouth that spake very great things”: the great things he speaks are the lies, that they are the people of God, that they are the Jews, the things he speaks against God. “Whose look was more stout than his fellows”: America is stronger than all the European countries.

“I beheld, and the same horn made war with the saints, and prevailed against them”. That same horn, America, makes war with us, and prevails against us in killing this flesh.

That war did not only happen in Africa. When they brought us to the shores of America, the war kept going: the Jim Crow laws, redlining, the black codes. The war never stopped, and it is going to happen again, with persecution and death.

“Until the Ancient of days came”. That war will not stop until Christ returns, casts down their thrones and destroys them. It is going to intensify in the end, and that intensification is called Jacob’s trouble.

precepts.why: “A great red dragon, having seven heads and ten horns”: the same thing read in Daniel 7. The seven heads and ten horns are the Caucasian race, Edom, the beast, and here the beast is called the great red dragon. The seven heads are Greece, Rome, Spain, France, Germany, Russia and Great Britain, and America.

sense.text:
This is what the dragon, the beast, Europe and America, will do to us. “And the dragon was wroth with the woman”: the dragon will be angry with us, because we will be teaching against all his lies, against white Jesus and Christianity, and we will destroy his lies. The woman is the twelve tribes.

“And went to make war with the remnant of her seed”: war with the beast. That goes back to Revelation 13:15, whoever would not worship the beast put to death. The remnant are those “which keep the commandments of God”: that do not worship the beast, do not follow their religion, speak against their lies, keep the Sabbath and God’s high holy days.

That war has started already, and it will intensify and get worse. They send agents among us, FBI agents, to monitor us and set us up. The war will start with us being fired from our jobs and being kicked off their economic system so we cannot buy and sell. The digital ID of the one world order will put everything about you on one system, and if you say anything against them, they shut down your bank account and your job. A few years ago, when the Bishop and the brothers were travelling, the brothers’ cards would not work: the banks said they were a hate group and froze the accounts. That is war.

When it says no man should buy or sell, it is geared against the saints. Then we will have to work together, the doctors and dentists among us serving the brothers, and become self-sufficient. The Lord knows what he is doing.

precepts.why:
This is why the dragon will be wroth. “The Spirit of life from God entered into them”: by the prophecy, the Holy Spirit will enter into us. “And they stood upon their feet”: Israel will start waking up all over the world, and our people will stand up and profess that they are the children of God, in the millions.

“And great fear fell upon them which saw them.” Great fear will come upon the nations that see us, asking who told these people they are the Jews. But that fear will turn into anger, and they will persecute us.

sense.text: “Why do the heathen rage, and the people imagine a vain thing?” Why are the nations angry and the people imagining lies? Because of the teachings of Christ. It happened in the time of the apostles and it is happening again today.
“The kings of the earth set themselves, and the rulers take counsel together, against the Lord, and against his anointed”. The anointed ones are the real Christians. The rulers are against them.

“Let us break their bands asunder”: our bands are the congregations we have set up all over the world, and the nations want to destroy them. Even here in America they are scheming: let us break their groups up. “And cast away their cords from us”: they do not want to hear the teachings of Christ any more.

Captain OC was out at a church bringing out the word that a man praying with his head covered dishonours his head, Christ. The following week his boss saw the video and fired him. Was it evil what he was saying? This is the cross you have to bear: teaching this gospel, you will be persecuted and hated, and some of you will lose your job. Whether to keep teaching is your decision to make.

In France the government has dissolved the congregation and said they do not want us teaching in France, on pain of fines and jail. They came for one brother, married to a French citizen with two French children, and called his class videos hatred and a threat to French security. They told him he could stay if he stopped teaching and cut all affiliation, and he said he would not stop teaching the word of God. This morning they came to his house, took him from his wife and kids, and detained him. That is affliction for the word of God’s sake, and that is the beast making war with us.

The same is coming to America. In Congress it came out that there is a secret list of designated terrorist organizations, and an order to designate groups that have anti-Christian values. Those are us. The FBI speaks of tracking African-Americans as racially motivated violent extremists, the same charge put on the brother in France. They tried to put the Jersey City shooting on the Israelites, though no Israelites had anything to do with it. They have sent agents among us in France, New York and Atlanta. So do what is right and speak righteousness.

precepts.why: “Blessed are ye, when men shall revile you, and persecute you, and shall say all manner of evil against you falsely, for my sake.” This is nothing new. When you teach the gospel and a government persecutes you for his name’s sake, Christ says you are blessed. All the brothers going through that persecution are blessed, and a blessing is coming to Captain OC, who lost his job.

We are at war, and in war there are casualties; nobody fights a war without soldiers dropping. “Thou therefore endure hardness, as a good soldier of Jesus Christ.” The hardness is the persecution, when bad things happen to us, when we are put in prison, as the brother in France was taken in the middle of the night from his family. We have to endure it, because we are soldiers, and God only chooses you in affliction.

How do you endure hardness? You study, you pray, and when things get bad you trust in the Lord. You must find a relationship with the Lord, because when you get locked up for teaching the gospel, we are not going to be there with you. It is you, the scriptures you have learned, and the Holy Spirit in you. You must find your comfort there.

sense.text: How do we overcome this beast, his mark and his lies? We go to war with him and tear down every lie he taught on this earth. “Now is come salvation, and strength, and the kingdom of our God, and the power of his Christ: for the accuser of our brethren is cast down”. The brethren are the blacks and Hispanics, the twelve tribes of Israel. The accuser is Esau, the white man. He calls us a hate group, violent, hateful, a threat to society, accusing us “before our God day and night”, and God says he is cast down.

“And they overcame him”: this is how we overcome the so-called white man, France, America and all Europe, and win this war. Not by picking up guns or weapons, but “by the blood of the Lamb”, through the blood of Christ, “and by the word of their testimony”, by us teaching the word of God.

“And they loved not their lives unto the death.” You cannot love your life, because teaching the word of God and holding the testimony, the beast will kill some of us, deport us, or put us in prison. That is what this is gearing up for. They are watching, but we will not stop teaching. We must stand stiffly for the word of God and pray that when that time comes we do exactly what that brother in France did. That is the proving time, being tried in the furnace of affliction, and that test will tell whether the Lord will choose you. Your life belongs to Christ.

precepts.why:
“Fear none of those things which thou shalt suffer”. Christ says we are going to suffer; right now that brother is suffering in prison for teaching the word of God. But we should not fear it. “Behold, the devil shall cast some of you into prison, that ye may be tried; and ye shall have tribulation ten days”.

“Be thou faithful unto death”: that goes back to loving not their lives unto the death. Christ is telling these men, some of you will die, but take your death. “And I will give thee a crown of life.” Stay faithful when tribulation and affliction come your way, when your life is in jeopardy for his word and his testimony, and you will get the crown of life.

This is war. Do not be scared of any government. Teach the word, teach the Bible. If they condemn you, let it be for the word of God, for what this Bible says, not for anything you did wrong.

sense.text: “I will shew unto thee the judgment of the great whore that sitteth upon many waters”. The great whore is Babylon, America. The great whore is the beast, namely the head of the beast, which is America.

“And I saw the woman drunken with the blood of the saints, and with the blood of the martyrs of Jesus”. This has not happened yet. America will be drunken with the blood of the saints: a lot of the saints are going to die in America in these last days. That goes back to Revelation 13:15, whoever did not worship the beast or his image put to death, and to Revelation 12, they loved not their lives unto the death.

There will be martyrs in America, brothers made a spectacle for the whole world and put to death. “And when I saw her, I wondered with great admiration.”

precepts.why:
“And in her was found the blood of prophets”. In her, in Babylon, in America, is found the blood of prophets. The prophets are on the earth today, and if you say you are a prophet, you must make up your mind and mould it: anything could happen to you. You could be put in prison or put to death; America could deport you or put you on an island somewhere where nobody knows where you are.

“And of saints, and of all that were slain upon the earth.” It will not just be us: all that are slain on the earth are the people America will be killing too. All the wars and disasters taking place on the earth will be because of America.

“Rejoice over her, thou heaven, and ye holy apostles and prophets”: the holy apostles and prophets are here in America. “For God hath avenged you on her.” God is going to take vengeance on Babylon, on America, because of the saints and the prophets.

“The violence done to me and to my flesh be upon Babylon, shall the inhabitant of Zion say”. This happened back then, but it is also speaking of the future: God is going to bring judgment on them for the violence they have done and will do to us. Zion is a nation, Israel. “And my blood upon the inhabitants of Chaldea, shall Jerusalem say.”

“Behold, I will plead thy cause, and take vengeance for thee”: the Lord will plead our cause and take vengeance for us. “And make her springs dry. And Babylon shall become heaps, a dwellingplace for dragons”: that is not the past. It is the future, Mystery Babylon the Great of Revelation 17, which is America, that great harlot.

“The souls of them that were slain for the word of God, and for the testimony which they held”. Teaching the word of God, you could lose your life; you become a threat to national security, as they wrote in the paperwork for that brother in France. The US government has a list of all of us teaching on the street and doing classes, and they are waiting for the right time. This is said so that when it happens you are not surprised. Believe the Lord, and believe his prophets.

They cried, “How long, O Lord, holy and true, dost thou not judge and avenge our blood on them that dwell on the earth?” The saints that die want vengeance for their blood spilled on the earth. And “it was said unto them, that they should rest yet for a little season, until their fellowservants also and their brethren, that should be killed as they were, should be fulfilled.”

So before Christ returns and brings judgment, that whore has to be drunken with the blood of the saints, the prophets and the martyrs. Christ is not coming back until we have all been proven and that blood of God’s prophets and saints is shed.

sense.text:
“Regard not the wicked inventions of the heathen”. We cannot worry about what the heathen invent to do to us: prison, deportation, killing. God says do not fear their inventions. Why? Because of “the desire of those that keep thy testimonies in afflictions.”

This is about keeping God’s testimonies, his laws, in affliction, because that is when the Lord chooses his people, as Isaiah 48 says. When you keep his laws and his testimonies in affliction, that is when he chooses you.

precepts.why:
Everybody today thinks they understand the Bible, that they have the truth, and that God is dealing with them. God is not dealing with everyone; you will know them by their fruits. But this is when it will be made plain: “Then shall they be known, who are my chosen; and they shall be tried as the gold in the fire.”

The verses before speak of when affliction comes upon us, the great insurrection, when they rise up and persecution starts. That is when you will know who really believes this Bible. Let the government come down on the Israelites, not if but when, when the heathen rage and say let us break their bands asunder, as they are doing in France, and see how many still teach the gospel and stand ten toes down. How many will keep God’s testimonies in affliction? That is when you will know who God’s chosen are.

Build yourselves up and pray that when that day comes you are able to endure. If you are studying, praying and applying, you will endure. If you are fake and phony and full of hatred and sin, you will not.

sense.text: This is the end of everything, the end of the persecution and affliction. “I Esdras saw upon the mount Sion a great people, whom I could not number, and they all praised the Lord with songs.” That great people is us, delivered, having overcome the beast.

“There was a young man of a high stature, taller than all the rest, and upon every one of their heads he set crowns”. Christ puts crowns on the heads of all of us that make it, that endure the affliction on this side of the world.
“Sir, what are these?” He asks what they are because they have on their heavenly garment, the angelic form.

“These be they that have put off the mortal clothing, and put on the immortal”: they do not have mortal, fleshly bodies any more; they have immortal bodies. “And have confessed the name of God”: they were on the earth teaching the gospel. “Now are they crowned, and receive palms.”

“It is the Son of God, whom they have confessed in the world.” You have to confess the Son of God in affliction. It is not speaking of going on the street now while everything is good and somebody might speak loud at you. It is speaking of the heathen raging and the people imagining a vain thing: calling us a hate group, lying that we are violent, that we hate and abuse women. They told that brother in France he could stay if he stopped teaching the gospel, and he said no. That is keeping God’s testimony in affliction.

“Then began I greatly to commend them that stood so stiffly for the name of the Lord.” The key is standing stiffly, unmovable. Nothing should move you when it comes to the word of God.

precepts.why:
“A great multitude, which no man could number”: the same great people we just read in 2 Esdras, the people upon mount Sion, the twelve tribes of Israel. They are “of all nations, and kindreds, and people, and tongues”: that is Zion that was scattered into all nations, peoples and tongues. That is how easy it is.

They “stood before the throne, and before the Lamb, clothed with white robes, and palms in their hands”: they got that crown; they have put on the immortal and taken off the mortal. And they cried, “Salvation to our God”: our God, which is possessive.

Somebody else asked the same question as Ezra: “What are these which are arrayed in white robes? and whence came they?” And the answer: “These are they which came out of great tribulation”. Those are the twelve tribes that were persecuted by the beast.

That great tribulation is persecution, Jacob’s trouble, being persecuted for the word of God. Endure it, and you will get that crown.
